headline: EPFO's big decision... Now those with salaries up to 25 thousand will get PF coverage, lakhs of employees will benefit
summary: The Union Cabinet approved raising the wage ceiling for mandatory Employees' Provident Fund Organisation coverage from 15,000 rupees to 25,000 rupees per month. The change would bring more employees under mandatory PF coverage.
why: The EPFO is India's statutory retirement savings body, and changes to its coverage rules affect pension fund contributions, employer payroll costs and the size of the formal workforce.
